title: Why Do Clouds Stay Up?
hook: Cloud drops are tiny, like dust.
narration: Cloud drops are tiny, like dust.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Clouds Stay Up.
Air moving up can hold them.
Let me show you that in 3D.
When drops grow heavy, they fall as rain.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
A cloud is a floating crowd of droplets.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Cloud drops are tiny, like dust.
The pictures today are a new cloud world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do clouds stay up.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
